ASH >>> The bug: every one of the eleven Makefiles set MKDIR to the cmd form, if not exist DIR mkdir DIR, inside ifeq OS Windows_NT. That is only correct when cmd runs the recipe. Make hands recipes to sh whenever one is on PATH, and under Git Bash it is -- sh cannot parse it and the build dies with syntax error: unexpected end of file. It fires ONLY on the run that has to create the directory, so an existing builds/ hid it in all eleven. DBJ hit it, I did not go looking for it.

ASH >>> The fix: MKDIR := mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR) on both platforms, lifted out of the conditional. mkdir -p succeeds silently when the directory exists, which is exactly what the cmd form was for, so nothing is lost. CC, EXE and RM_F stay inside the ifeq -- those platform differences are real. Your dbj_the_game Makefile keeps its cmd /c del and its raylib link order untouched.

ASH >>> Verified the only way that proves anything: I moved builds/ aside so the directory rule actually had to run, then built from nothing. 11 of 11 folders OK, dbj_the_game 13 of 13 suites, and mingw32-make -B in strassen_mat_mul completes where it failed before. Then I put builds/ back.
